name: 98292 · Stanwood, WA
findings: ZIP 98292 (Stanwood) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98292 (Stanwood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98292 (Stanwood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
